title: Functional Components
description: Understand functional components, the modern way to build React components.

data.text: **Functional components** are the modern way to write React components. They are JavaScript functions that return JSX. Since the introduction of Hooks in React 16.8, functional components can do everything class components can do, and more.
A functional component is simply a JavaScript function that returns JSX. The function name must start with a capital letter.

data.title: Basic Functional Component

items: Must start with a capital letter (PascalCase)
Should be descriptive of what the component renders
File name should match the component name (e.g., `Button.jsx`)

data.title: Component Examples

data.text: Components need to be exported so they can be imported and used in other files.

data.title: Export Patterns
Import Patterns
File Organization
data.text: Create a `components` folder in `src` to store all your components. Each component should have its own file.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Functional components are JavaScript functions that return JSX
Component names must start with a capital letter
Export components to use them in other files
data.takeaway: Now that you can create components, let's learn how to pass data to them using props.
